blurb: Cedar Lake Farm is a 103-acre natural area in Blairstown Township, NJ, featuring meadows, mixed forest, hemlock woodland, successional scrub-cedar, ponds, and riverine habitats. It is bisected by the Paulinskill Valley Trail, a 27-mile multi-use rail-trail. The farm is open year-round for various outdoor recreational activities but prohibits hunting and motorized use.
